roadmap.title: Monk save: the Neuron choice
roadmap.description: Start a Monk campaign only for Stolen Enlightenment. Reach Looks to the Moon, eat or carry off one of her Neurons on the first visit, and hibernate.

roadmap.title: Survivor: early Passages and Looks to the Moon
roadmap.description: Start the main Survivor campaign. Leave Looks to the Moon's Neurons alone and hibernate for A New Friend. Build the early Passages while exploring: The Survivor first, then the diets, kills, Lizards and the Lizard friend.

roadmap.title: Survivor: Echoes and Pilgrimage
roadmap.description: Meet all six Echoes, four of them before Five Pebbles, and travel through Karma Gates for The Nomad.

roadmap.title: Survivor: Five Pebbles and Ascension
roadmap.description: Meet Five Pebbles, finish the region and Scavenger Passages, pick up colored Pearls, force the starving cycles for The Martyr, then dive into the Void Sea.

roadmap.title: Hunter campaign
roadmap.description: Play Hunter with a strict cycle limit: deliver the Green Neuron and ascend.

roadmap.title: Gourmand: Migration
roadmap.description: Reach Journey's End and, if wanted, finish the Food Quest.

roadmap.title: Slugpups
roadmap.description: With Slugpups unlocked, hibernate with friendly pups as Survivor, Hunter or Gourmand.

roadmap.title: Artificer: Closure
roadmap.description: Cross Shaded Citadel and The Exterior to Metropolis and end the Chieftain Scavenger.

roadmap.title: Rivulet: An Old Friend
roadmap.description: Carry the Rarefaction Cell from The Rot to The Heart and return to Looks to the Moon.

roadmap.title: Spearmaster: Messenger
roadmap.description: Carry the pearl from Five Pebbles to Looks to the Moon and on to the Communications Array.

roadmap.title: Saint: The Cycle
roadmap.description: Visit Saint's Echoes, then ascend through Rubicon.

roadmap.title: Watcher: prologue and early warps
roadmap.description: Finish the Spinning Top prologue and create a Bad Warp.

roadmap.title: Watcher: Ripple 7 and The Prince
roadmap.description: Unlock The Throne, meet The Prince and spread Sentient Rot before the Weaver is met four times.

roadmap.title: Watcher: Ripple 9 and Spinning Top
roadmap.description: Reach Ripple 9, enter Ripplespace, travel to Ancient Urban and finish the Spinning Top ending.

roadmap.title: Watcher: The Weaver
roadmap.description: Meet the Weaver, gain Weaving, seal Warp Points and finish the Weaver ending.

roadmap.title: Watcher: Ascension ending
roadmap.description: Light the three obelisks in Daemon.

roadmap.title: Arena Challenges
roadmap.description: Win all 70 Challenges with the campaign sets unlocked.

achievements.description: This land has become your home
achievements.summary: Hibernate through 5 cycles with Karma at its maximum.

guide.context: Pips are never lost and the cycles do not need to be in a row. A death lowers Karma, so that cycle may not count.

steps.text: Begin every cycle with your Karma full. A new campaign tops out at 5.
Reach a shelter and hibernate. Each cycle that counts fills one pip on the Passage wheel.
Repeat until all 5 pips are filled.

achievements.description: Path of the carnivore
achievements.summary: Hibernate after 6 cycles in which you ate only meat.

guide.context: Each clean cycle adds 1 and each death removes 0.5. Hibernating after eating plant food or a @item{Neuron} resets progress to 0; a cycle with no eating changes nothing. A @enemy{Vulture Grub} can only be eaten dead. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} first and can be built at the same time as @mechanic{The Saint}.

steps.text: Eat only meat: @enemy{Batfly}, @enemy{Infant Noodlefly}, centipedes, @enemy{Eggbug}, @enemy{Jellyfish}, @enemy{Hazer} or @enemy{Vulture Grub}. Creature corpses also count for Slugcats that eat them.
Hibernate after each such cycle. Eat no plant food.
Repeat until progress reaches 6.

achievements.description: Path of the vegetarian
achievements.summary: Hibernate after 6 cycles in which you ate only plant food.

guide.context: Each clean cycle adds 1 and each death removes 0.5. Hibernating after eating any meat resets progress to 0; a cycle with no eating changes nothing. Hit a Popcorn Plant with a spear to open it, and carry Bubble Fruit into water to crack it. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} first.

steps.text: Eat only plant food: @item{Blue Fruit}, @item{Popcorn Plant} fruit, @item{Bubble Fruit}, @item{Slime Mold} or @item{Neuron}. With Downpour, Lilypuck, Glow Weed, Dandelion Peach, Gooieduck seeds and Fire Eggs also count.
Hibernate after each such cycle. Eat no @enemy{Batfly}, @enemy{Vulture Grub} or any other creature.
Repeat until progress reaches 6.

achievements.description: Path of the pacifist
achievements.summary: Hibernate after 6 cycles in which you did not harm any creature.

guide.context: Each clean cycle adds 1 and each death removes 0.5. Any other harm resets progress to 0. Harming @enemy{Batfly}, @enemy{Infant Centipede}, @enemy{Coalescipede}, @enemy{Leech}, @enemy{Jellyfish} or @enemy{Vulture Grub} is allowed, and eating a @enemy{Batfly} is fine. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} first.

steps.text: Do not hit or kill any creature, and do not get blamed for a death. Thrown Rocks, Bubble Fruit, Spears, Grenades, Spore Puffs and Beehives all count as harm when they hit.
Hibernate after each clean cycle.
Repeat until progress reaches 6.

achievements.description: Path of aggression
achievements.summary: Score 7 kills across back-to-back cycles, hibernating after each cycle that has a kill.

guide.context: A cycle with no kills resets progress to 0 and a death removes 1. Kills of @enemy{Batfly}, @enemy{Coalescipede}, @enemy{Leech}, @enemy{Infant Centipede}, @enemy{Vulture Grub} and @enemy{Hazer} do not count. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} on an earlier cycle.

steps.text: Kill at least 1 creature each cycle and hibernate. Progress rises by the number you killed.
Keep going until progress reaches 7. Killing 7 creatures in one cycle finishes it at once.

achievements.description: Predator has become prey
achievements.summary: Kill 6 different types of Lizard.

guide.context: To kill a Lizard, stun it with a thrown Rock, then stab its back with a Spear until it dies; Spears bounce off its head. Hibernate after each kill so the game records it, in any order across the whole campaign. With Downpour, Cyan, Red, Caramel and Strawberry Lizards also count, so any six types finish it; Salamanders and Eel Lizards never count. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} first.

collectibles.name: Green Lizard
collectibles.method: It has the most health of the six. An Explosive Spear is the safest way to kill it.

collectibles.name: Pink Lizard
collectibles.location: @loc{Sky Islands}, @loc{Chimney Canopy}, @loc{Garbage Wastes}, @loc{Industrial Complex}, @loc{Outskirts}; Survivor and Monk also meet them in @loc{Drainage System} and @loc{Shaded Citadel}
collectibles.method: Use the stun-and-stab method described above.

collectibles.name: Blue Lizard
collectibles.method: It is weak, so a few hits are enough.

collectibles.name: White Lizard
collectibles.method: It is the most dangerous of the six. An Explosive Spear is the safest way to kill it.

collectibles.name: Yellow Lizard
collectibles.location: @loc{The Exterior}, @loc{Sky Islands}; also @loc{Farm Arrays} for Survivor and Monk
collectibles.method: Use the stun-and-stab method described above.

collectibles.name: Black Lizard
collectibles.method: It is blind and lives in dark places.

achievements.description: Embraced by a new tribe
achievements.summary: Raise your global Scavenger reputation to 80 (90 as Monk).

guide.context: Reputation is shared by all Scavengers and drops after hostile acts. Paying a toll costs a little reputation. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} first, and the Passage can be taken away again if reputation falls.

steps.text: Give Scavengers Pearls: hold a Pearl in your stomach and throw it near them. This is the fastest way to raise reputation.
Help Scavengers instead of attacking them. Save them from attackers and drop a spear near them as a peace offering. Never steal their gear, harass them or kill them.
At a Scavenger Toll (a large mask with hanging pearls), pay 1 Pearl or 4 spears so they stay friendly.
Check the Passage wheel on the hibernation screen until it fills.

achievements.description: Your travels have taken you far
achievements.summary: Hibernate once in each main region.

guide.context: Only the region where you sleep counts, and any order works. The base game has 12 regions. Downpour adds Pipeyard, and every Slugcat other than Survivor, Monk and Hunter adds one more. If you use a Passage token to save time, choose a shelter next to the Karma Gate of the target region. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} first.

achievements.description: History lessons
achievements.summary: Touch 3 colored Pearls, hibernating after each.

guide.context: An Iterator does not need to read the Pearl. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} first. For some Slugcats you must also have met @npc{Looks to the Moon}.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Five Pebbles} so you have the Mark of Communication.
Pick up a colored Pearl, for example the Pale Yellow Pearl at @loc{Looks to the Moon}.
Hibernate to record its color. Repeat until 3 pips are filled; one cycle can add several.

achievements.description: One need not travel alone
achievements.summary: Hibernate with a fully tamed Lizard in your shelter for 3 cycles in a row.

guide.context: The Lizard must be inside the shelter each cycle. A cycle without it resets progress to 0. An untamed Lizard adds less progress and may need extra cycles, and even a tamed Lizard can bite when hurt. Needs @mechanic{The Survivor} first.

steps.text: Tame a @enemy{Lizard} by feeding it creatures, preferably dead ones so it does not run off. A @enemy{Blue Lizard} tames easily and keeps up with you.
Bring it into your shelter and hibernate with it.
Do the same for 3 cycles in a row.

achievements.description: Meet the Echo Nineteen Spades, Endless Reflections in Chimney Canopy.
achievements.summary: Meet the Echo Nineteen Spades, Endless Reflections in Chimney Canopy.

guide.context: Meeting an Echo ends the cycle and returns you to your last shelter. Hibernate normally once before your first Echo, or the campaign restarts instead.

steps.text: Go to the top centre of @loc{Chimney Canopy}, between the gates to @loc{Sky Islands} (west) and @loc{The Exterior} (east). First enter the area once (a blue flash shows an Echo lives here), then return on a later cycle with Karma at its maximum.

achievements.description: Meet the Echo Droplets upon Five Large Droplets in Sky Islands.
achievements.summary: Meet the Echo Droplets upon Five Large Droplets in Sky Islands.

guide.context: Meeting an Echo ends the cycle and returns you to your last shelter. Hibernate normally once before your first Echo, or the campaign restarts instead.

steps.text: In @loc{Sky Islands}, go above the tunnel full of yellow Lizards near the gate to @loc{Farm Arrays}. The Echo hangs near a lone pipe left of the middle. First enter the area once (a blue flash shows an Echo lives here), then return on a later cycle with Karma at its maximum.

achievements.description: Meet the Echo A Bell, Eighteen Amber Beads in Farm Arrays.
achievements.summary: Meet the Echo A Bell, Eighteen Amber Beads in Farm Arrays.

guide.context: Meeting an Echo ends the cycle and returns you to your last shelter. Hibernate normally once before your first Echo, or the campaign restarts instead.

steps.text: Head to the bottom-right corner of @loc{Farm Arrays}, by the gate to @loc{Outskirts}. Descend the pipe in the pit on its left and then use the left-hand pipe. The Echo floats high over a patch of Worm Grass. First enter the area once (a blue flash shows an Echo lives here), then return on a later cycle with Karma at its maximum.

achievements.description: Meet the Echo Four Needles under Plentiful Leaves in Shaded Citadel.
achievements.summary: Meet the Echo Four Needles under Plentiful Leaves in Shaded Citadel.

guide.context: Meeting an Echo ends the cycle and returns you to your last shelter. Hibernate normally once before your first Echo, or the campaign restarts instead.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Shaded Citadel}, below the west end of the eastern bridge toward @loc{Shoreline}. Take the top-right pipe at the crossroads to reach the grotto. First enter the area once (a blue flash shows an Echo lives here), then return on a later cycle with Karma at its maximum.

achievements.displayName: Six Grains of Gravel, Mountains Abound
achievements.description: Meet the Echo Six Grains of Gravel, Mountains Abound in The Exterior.
achievements.summary: Meet the Echo Six Grains of Gravel, Mountains Abound in The Exterior.

guide.context: Meeting an Echo ends the cycle and returns you to your last shelter. Hibernate normally once before your first Echo, or the campaign restarts instead.

steps.text: Climb @loc{The Wall} in @loc{The Exterior} to the top, near the access shaft to @npc{Five Pebbles}.
The Echo is at the top on your first visit, whatever your Karma.

achievements.description: Meet the Echo Two Sprouts, Twelve Brackets in Subterranean.
achievements.summary: Meet the Echo Two Sprouts, Twelve Brackets in Subterranean.

guide.context: Meeting an Echo ends the cycle and returns you to your last shelter. Hibernate normally once before your first Echo, or the campaign restarts instead.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Subterranean} through the gate from @loc{Farm Arrays}.
The Echo sits in the cave on the right wall of the big ravine beside the gate. It shows up on your first visit at any Karma.

achievements.description: Raise maximum Karma to 10 by meeting Echoes, without having visited Five Pebbles.
achievements.summary: Raise maximum Karma to 10 by meeting Echoes, without having visited Five Pebbles.

guide.context: If you already met Five Pebbles on this campaign, start a new one. As Hunter or Gourmand, Five Pebbles counts like one Echo, so he may be one of the four but must not give the last increase.

steps.text: Do not meet @npc{Five Pebbles} until you have met 4 Echoes.
Meet 4 Echoes. The first raises maximum Karma from 5 to 7 and each later one adds 1. The Echoes on @loc{The Wall} and in @loc{Subterranean} need no earlier visit.
The achievement unlocks when the fourth Echo takes Karma to 10.

achievements.description: As Survivor or Monk, eat or carry off one of Looks to the Moon's Neurons on your first visit, then hibernate.
achievements.summary: As Survivor or Monk, eat or carry off one of Looks to the Moon's Neurons on your first visit, then hibernate.

guide.context: Only the first visit counts. Taking a Neuron on a later visit does nothing, and eating all 5 kills her. If you hibernate with full food while holding the Neuron, it still counts and you can return it next cycle. You cannot also earn A New Friend on the same campaign.

steps.text: Follow the @npc{Yellow Overseer} east through @loc{Shoreline} to @npc{Looks to the Moon}.
Catch one of the 5 white @item{Neuron}s above her and eat it, or carry it away.
Hibernate. You see a vision of her injured and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: As Survivor or Monk, meet Looks to the Moon and hibernate without eating or taking any of her Neurons.
achievements.summary: As Survivor or Monk, meet Looks to the Moon and hibernate without eating or taking any of her Neurons.

guide.context: Do this on your first meeting. Eating or taking a Neuron earns Stolen Enlightenment instead and ends your chance at this one for the campaign.

steps.text: Follow the @npc{Yellow Overseer} east through @loc{Shoreline} to @npc{Looks to the Moon}.
Leave the white @item{Neuron}s above her alone.
Hibernate on the same cycle. You see a vision of her and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Meet Five Pebbles in his chamber, then hibernate.
achievements.summary: Meet Five Pebbles in his chamber, then hibernate.

guide.context: Survivor and Monk get the Mark of Communication and maximum Karma 10 from him. Visit once only: a second visit angers him and a third kills you. For Pilgrimage, meet 4 Echoes before him.

steps.text: After @npc{Looks to the Moon}, follow the @npc{Yellow Overseer} to @npc{Five Pebbles} in the middle of his complex.
Listen to his directions and leave.
Hibernate. You see a vision and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: As Survivor or Monk, complete the ending by diving into the Void Sea in Depths.
achievements.summary: As Survivor or Monk, complete the ending by diving into the Void Sea in Depths.

steps.text: Reach maximum Karma 10. Five Pebbles gives it to Survivor and Monk, and four Echoes also reach it.
Travel to the far south-west of @loc{Subterranean} and enter @loc{Depths}. The Guardians let you pass only with Karma 10.
Dive into the Void Sea, let the Void Worm pull you down, then swim to the light.

achievements.description: As Hunter, give your Green Neuron to one of two Iterators: Looks to the Moon, or else Five Pebbles.
achievements.summary: As Hunter, give your Green Neuron to one of two Iterators: Looks to the Moon, or else Five Pebbles.

guide.context: You have 19 cycles and they count down, and Passage tokens do not work. Five Pebbles adds 5 cycles and one Echo-sized step of Karma.

steps.text: Start a Hunter campaign, which unlocks after you finish Survivor or Monk. Keep the @item{Green Neuron} in your stomach.
Travel from @loc{Farm Arrays} to @npc{Looks to the Moon} in @loc{Shoreline}, or to @npc{Five Pebbles}.
Give them the Neuron.

achievements.description: As Hunter, ascend through the Void Sea.
achievements.summary: As Hunter, ascend through the Void Sea.

guide.context: You may skip both Iterators. A Vulture Mask frightens most Lizards for around 17 seconds. Holding Down in a shelter that lacks food forces hibernation; it still raises Karma and a later death rewinds to your last normal save. If your cycles run out the campaign ends and you must start a new Hunter campaign.

steps.text: Raise maximum Karma to 10. Hunter needs 4 increases from Echoes, and Five Pebbles can replace one of them.
Echoes appear on your first visit if your Karma is high enough.
Before your cycles run out, go to the far south-west of @loc{Subterranean} and dive into the Void Sea in @loc{Depths}.

achievements.description: As Gourmand, walk to the far west end of Journey's End in Outer Expanse.
achievements.summary: As Gourmand, walk to the far west end of Journey's End in Outer Expanse.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Five Pebbles}. Outer Expanse opens for you afterward.
Go to the west end of @loc{Subterranean}, enter @loc{Outer Expanse} and keep heading west.
Reach the Orb Tree in @loc{Journey's End}. You lose control and the ending plays.

achievements.description: As Artificer, kill the Chieftain Scavenger in Metropolis, or try to ascend.
achievements.summary: As Artificer, kill the Chieftain Scavenger in Metropolis, or try to ascend.

guide.context: More Scavengers keep joining from the left, so fight on the right. Stick or remove spears and explosives first so the Chieftain cannot use them. Afterward your maximum Karma stays at 1.

steps.text: Take the new shortcut into @loc{Shaded Citadel}, cross @loc{The Exterior}, and climb toward @npc{Five Pebbles} until you can enter @loc{Metropolis}.
Head east to the House of Braids, also called @loc{12th Council Pillar}, then ascend to its highest point.
Provoke the @enemy{Chieftain Scavenger}. Knock off its 3 armor plates, then land 3 to 4 spear hits.
Pick up its mask to end the fight.

achievements.description: As Rivulet, restore power with Five Pebbles' Rarefaction Cell and return to Looks to the Moon, or ascend.
achievements.summary: As Rivulet, restore power with Five Pebbles' Rarefaction Cell and return to Looks to the Moon, or ascend.

guide.context: Holding Pick up gives a gravity boost for about 15 seconds. Do not kill Looks to the Moon, or the cell cannot be placed. If you lose the cell you may need to restart the cycle.

steps.text: Go to @npc{Five Pebbles}. He tells you to take his core to Looks to the Moon.
From his chamber go south-west to @loc{Linear Systems Rail} in @loc{The Rot}. Time your jump into the small anti-gravity room and take the @item{Rarefaction Cell}.
Carry it to @npc{Looks to the Moon}. She tells you to install it beneath her.
Leave her area to the west, go south, then south-east into @loc{Submerged Superstructure}. Follow the machinery north around to @loc{The Heart} and activate the cell.
You are sent to the Bitter Aerie. Head west to the gate back to @loc{Shoreline} and take the shortcut into her chamber.

achievements.description: As Spearmaster, take the pearl rewritten by Looks to the Moon up the tower named the Communications Array in Sky Islands.
achievements.summary: As Spearmaster, take the pearl rewritten by Looks to the Moon up the tower named the Communications Array in Sky Islands.

guide.context: Do not drop the pearl; the walk is long.

steps.text: Go to @npc{Five Pebbles} to deliver your message. The access shaft from @loc{The Wall} works. He throws you out holding a pearl. Do not go back in.
Carry the pearl to @npc{Looks to the Moon}. In @loc{Waterfront Facility} keep going north and north-east to a huge room outside her chamber, go west to Luna and climb north to her.
Give her the pearl. She rewrites it.
Carry it to the tall tower in @loc{Sky Islands} and scale it. The pearl lifts off and the ending plays.

achievements.description: As Saint, ascend at the top of Rubicon.
achievements.summary: As Saint, ascend at the top of Rubicon.

guide.context: Saint meets Echoes at any Karma, and an animation plays when you enter a region with an unmet Echo.

steps.text: Meet Saint's Echoes. They need no Karma: @loc{Sky Islands}, @loc{Chimney Canopy}, @loc{Shoreline} (Frigid Coast), @loc{Silent Construct}, @loc{Farm Arrays}, @loc{Subterranean} and @loc{Drainage System} (Undergrowth).
With Karma at its maximum, go to @loc{Subterranean} and drop into @loc{Rubicon}.
Climb north through Rubicon to its final room, then swim up the Void Sea. You do not control the last part.

achievements.description: Complete all 70 Challenges in Arena.
achievements.summary: Complete all 70 Challenges in Arena.

guide.context: Challenges are in the Arena menu. Survivor and Monk sets are open from the start. The Hunter set needs a finished Survivor or Monk campaign, and the Gourmand, Artificer, Rivulet, Spearmaster and Saint sets need their own campaigns. Bonus challenges unlock after 5, then 10, and so on of the first 56; Challenge 70 needs the first 69. A failed attempt restarts the challenge.

collectibles.method: Befriend a creature.

collectibles.method: Gain 30 points.

collectibles.name: 18. Sky Islands
collectibles.method: Gain 30 points.

collectibles.method: Gain 12 points. Slam Miros Birds from the ceiling pipe.

collectibles.name: 20. Subterranean
collectibles.method: Gain 30 points.

collectibles.name: 21. Filtration System
collectibles.method: Gain 30 points.

collectibles.name: 24. Infinite Utility

collectibles.name: 26. Noot Scoot

collectibles.method: Gain 18 points. Combine a Lantern with a Noodlefly Egg to make a Vulture Grub, stack spears at the top and call a Vulture.

collectibles.name: 28. Flushed
collectibles.method: Gain 35 points.

collectibles.name: 29. Lamplighter
collectibles.method: Gain 8 points.

collectibles.name: 30. Surrounded
collectibles.method: Kill all creatures.

collectibles.name: 31. Blast Fishing
collectibles.method: Gain 5 points. The room holds 5 Glow Weed.

collectibles.name: 32. Hard Boiled

collectibles.name: 33. Perfect Parries
collectibles.method: Parry 4 attacks. Deflect Scavenger spears with the concussive blast; Mushrooms slow time.

collectibles.name: 34. Patrol
collectibles.method: Kill all creatures.

collectibles.name: 35. Sheep Dog
collectibles.method: Keep the Lantern Mouse alive for 120 seconds. Shoot Cherrybombs from the Joke Rifle to scare Lizards off, or carry the Lantern Mouse in and out of pipes.

collectibles.name: 36. Submerged Superstructure
collectibles.method: Gain 30 points.

collectibles.name: 37. Shocking Pursuit
collectibles.method: Gain 20 points. Use Jellyfish to knock the eggs off the Eggbugs.

collectibles.name: 38. Wandering Lights
collectibles.method: Kill all creatures. Lure the Aquapedes onto land.

collectibles.name: 39. Electric Threading
collectibles.method: Gain 10 points. Exit the water facing the two lower poles and boost just before the surface.

collectibles.name: 40. Relentless Leapers
collectibles.method: Gain 3 points.

collectibles.name: 41. Snow and Ash
collectibles.method: Kill all creatures.

collectibles.name: 42. Daddy World
collectibles.method: Gain 3 points.

collectibles.name: 43. Claustrophobia
collectibles.method: Kill all creatures.

collectibles.name: 44. Caustic Vats

achievements.description: Complete all 75 quests in Expedition.
achievements.summary: Complete all 75 quests in Expedition.

guide.context: Choose a Slugcat, set 1 to 5 challenges (3 by default) and finish by hibernating with every challenge done. Quest rewards arrive right after an Expedition ends, and several quests can finish at once. Hidden challenges (the eye icon) show their text once the others are done. Hunter needs a finished Survivor or Monk campaign and the other five Slugcats need their own. Karma is capped at 5, and entering Depths ends the run. Level 20 needs 5,757 total points.

achievements.description: Earn The Martyr Passage by starving for 4 cycles.
achievements.summary: Earn The Martyr Passage by starving for 4 cycles.

guide.context: Dying halves your progress. Forced hibernation does not save the cycle and removes Karma Flower protection, and you cannot starve two cycles in a row. This needs at least 7 cycles. It can be earned before @mechanic{The Survivor}.

steps.text: In a shelter with less food than hibernation needs but at least 1 food pip, hold Down to force-hibernate. Each forced hibernation adds 27 of 100.
The next cycle you wake starved. Survive it and hibernate normally, which removes 2.
Repeat until the Passage fills. You earn it on the 4th forced hibernation.

achievements.description: Pass through 4 Karma Gates, each time leaving a different region.
achievements.summary: Pass through 4 Karma Gates, each time leaving a different region.

guide.context: Hibernating without a new pip resets your pips to 0, but starving does not. Meeting an Echo records the gates you crossed and keeps your progress. You do not need to sleep in a region to get its pip.

steps.text: Cross a Karma Gate. The region you leave gets a pip.
Keep moving onward. Going back into the region you just left gives no pip.
After 4 pips, hibernate or meet an Echo to record them.

achievements.description: Visit every Echo in your campaign.
achievements.summary: Visit every Echo in your campaign.

guide.context: Meeting an Echo fills its pip. Most Slugcats have these six. Artificer also has an Echo in Metropolis, and Saint has no Four Needles Echo but extra Echoes in Shoreline, Undergrowth and Silent Construct (where Six Grains of Gravel moves). It can be earned before @mechanic{The Survivor}.

achievements.description: Hibernate with friendly Slugpups until The Mother Passage fills.
achievements.summary: Hibernate with friendly Slugpups until The Mother Passage fills.

guide.context: Hibernating with no pup resets progress to 0. A pup without enough food does not count. You can carry only 2 pups at once, and a pup that dies stays dead unless you die and restart the cycle. It can be earned before @mechanic{The Survivor}.

steps.text: Unlock Slugpups by finishing Gourmand's Food Quest and reaching Journey's End. Slugpups then appear for Survivor, Hunter and Gourmand.
Hold a Slugpup's hand and hibernate together so it becomes your friend. Throw food at it to feed it.
Hibernate with your pups in the shelter. Each pup adds 1 per cycle. Stop at 5.

achievements.description: Astray
achievements.summary: As Watcher, finish the prologue so your Karma level is replaced by a Ripple level.

steps.text: Start in @loc{Hydroponics} and head east to @loc{Industrial Complex}.

Find the Echo @npc{Spinning Top} three times. Each meeting sends you back to @loc{Hydroponics}. Open regions: @loc{Farm Arrays} (through @loc{Outskirts}, south-west part), @loc{Shaded Citadel} (far east and a little south of Industrial Complex) and @loc{Chimney Canopy} (far north).
After the third meeting, step through the first Warp Point. Your Karma becomes Ripple and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Create a Bad Warp.
achievements.summary: Create a Bad Warp.

guide.context: Warp Points made without protection vanish after use. Warping through several Warp Points in one cycle also forces Bad Warps once Warp Fatigue is full (3 warps at Ripple 1 or 2, more at higher Ripple).

steps.text: Reach maximum Ripple 3 or more, which lets you create Warp Points.
Make sure no @item{Karma Flower} protection is active. Using the ability once spends it.
Create a Warp Point and step in. You land in a rotted version of a base-game region or in Outer Rim.

achievements.description: Travel to Ancient Urban.
achievements.summary: Enter Ancient Urban.

guide.context: The warp to Ancient Urban is one-way, and the cycle timer stops there.

steps.text: Reach Ripple 9 and hold Special to enter Ripplespace, then use any Ripple Warp to reach @loc{Daemon}.
In Daemon, use the Ripple Warp in room WRSA_D01 to reach @loc{Shattered Terrace}.
In Shattered Terrace, use the Ripple Warp in room WARA_P09 to reach @loc{Ancient Urban}.

achievements.description: Finish the Spinning Top ending.
achievements.summary: Reach the Spinning Top ending, which takes place in Ancient Urban.

guide.context: Meeting Spinning Top in their room first is optional but must happen before the baths meeting. After the baths meeting the route back to the entrance stays shut until the ending is done.

steps.text: At Ripple 9, enter Ripplespace and meet @npc{Spinning Top} in @loc{Shattered Terrace}. They open a one-way warp to @loc{Ancient Urban}.
Cross @loc{Ancient Urban} to the Void Fluid baths in the far west (room WAUA_BATH) and meet Spinning Top for the final time.
After the monologue and cutscene, go back to Spinning Top's room (WAUA_TOYS) and reach their toys to trigger the ending.

achievements.description: Meet The Prince.
achievements.summary: Meet The Prince for the first time.

guide.context: The Prince appears only after all four exit rooms are unlocked, so reach Ripple 7.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Outer Rim}: through the warp in @loc{Unfortunate Evolution}, a Warp Point from a rotted base-game region, or a Bad Warp.
Enter @loc{The Throne}. Return at maximum Ripple 3, 5 and 7 so the exit rooms unlock. After all four open, the rot cyst hatches into The Prince.
Go to The Prince's room and talk to them.

achievements.description: Finish the Sentient Rot ending.
achievements.summary: Complete the Sentient Rot ending by spreading Sentient Rot to every region it can reach, then returning to The Prince.

guide.context: Finish this before you meet The Weaver a fourth time. After that, your new abilities stop Rot from spreading and this ending is lost for the save, though The Prince can still be awakened. Rot needs several cycles to grow.

steps.text: Move through Warp Points, yours or natural ones, from an infected room into each Watcher region. The destination region becomes infected. Each Spinning Top meeting speeds up the spread.
Infect every Watcher region except @loc{Shattered Terrace}, @loc{Ancient Urban} and @loc{Daemon}, which cannot be infected.
Go back to The Prince in @loc{The Throne}. Karma Flowers sprout from their head and the ending begins.

achievements.description: Enter Ripplespace.
achievements.summary: Enter Ripplespace.

guide.context: Ripple Warps work only while you are in Ripplespace.

steps.text: Reach Ripple 9. Each Spinning Top meeting in a Watcher region raises maximum Ripple by 1, up to 9.
Hold Special to tear into Ripplespace instead of using camouflage.

achievements.description: Die to a Ripple Amoeba.
achievements.summary: Be killed by Ripple Amoebas.

steps.text: Reach Ripple 7 or higher.
Hold Special to open rifts that spawn @enemy{Ripple Amoeba}s. Turning camouflage on or off moves the rifts to your position.
Touch an Amoeba and stay put until the distortion fully closes and kills you.

achievements.description: Meet The Weaver.
achievements.summary: Meet The Weaver for the first time.

guide.context: Each sealed Warp Point can summon The Weaver once. Meeting The Weaver four times blocks the Sentient Rot ending, so finish The Prince first.

steps.text: Make Warp Points. Warp Points you create seal after 6 cycles.
On the hibernation map, look for a region icon with golden feathers falling. Go there and view the sealed, golden Warp Point on camera to make The Weaver appear.
Enter Ripplespace near it and follow the golden threads, or look for rooms that grow dark. Reach The Weaver.

achievements.description: Seal a Warp Point.
achievements.summary: Close a Warp Point with Weaving for the first time.

guide.context: Weaving also makes you immune to Rot, so do the Sentient Rot ending first.

steps.text: Meet The Weaver four times. After the fourth meeting Watcher gains Weaving and a halo appears.
Walk through a Warp Point that is not a one-way exit or a Ripple Warp. It turns golden and is sealed.

achievements.description: Finish the Weaver ending.
achievements.summary: Complete the Weaver ending by sealing all possible Warp Points and then meeting The Weaver.

guide.context: Warp Points in base-game regions, rotted base-game regions, Ancient Urban, Daemon and Shattered Terrace do not count. Spinning Top's warps count only after the Spinning Top ending.

steps.text: Use Weaving to seal every Warp Point you can.
After the last one, Watcher arrives in a cloudy place. Keep going as the color turns from blue to orange.
Reach The Weaver. The ending plays and you wake in @loc{Daemon}.

achievements.description: Read a Pearl at the machine in Ancient Urban.
achievements.summary: Use the reading machine in Ancient Urban on a Pearl for the first time.

guide.context: Two colored Pearls, Light Magenta and Orange, lie in Ancient Urban.

steps.text: Take any Pearl to the Pearl-reading machine in room WAUA_PEARL in @loc{Ancient Urban}.
Place the Pearl in the machine.

achievements.description: Finish the Ascension ending.
achievements.summary: Complete the Ascension ending in Daemon.

guide.context: The Sentient Rot ending is not required.

steps.text: Finish the Weaver ending as well as the Spinning Top one, and speak to The Prince once after Watcher wakes.
Return to @loc{Daemon}. The three obelisks light up; visit them.
Watcher faints and is carried through several places. Then descend into the Void Sea until the ending plays.
